signĭfĭcātōrĭus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.denoting, signifying, significatory (late Lat.); with gen. (like significativus): “verbum factitationis significatorium,” Tert. adv. Herm. 32 ; Ambros. Incarn. Dom. Sacr. § 98.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
